creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Upstream's new deps/libghostty-vt-third-party.json lists what libghostty-vt links: highway (Apache-2.0 OR BSD-3-Clause), simdutf (Apache-2.0 OR MIT), uucode (MIT AND Unicode-3.0) and wuffs (Apache-2.0 OR MIT). A search finds none of the first three in licenses/, NOTICE or tools/. highway and simdutf were already linked at the pin, so the gap exists today, including in the daemon Muster sends to other machines.

Add the `linked` entries to tools/ghostty-embeds.py and NOTICE. Wuffs reaches libghostty-vt only with vt-1.0.0, which falsifies the "carries none of these - it is the terminal state machine and nothing else" line ghostty-embeds.py:135 writes into licenses/GHOSTTY-EMBEDDED.md.
title: The binaries Muster ships carry highway, simdutf and uucode with no attribution
